description:
Cast Runed Servitor by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Runed Servitor.
Runed Servitor dies, triggering Mortuary and Runed Servitor.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Runed Servitor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Runed Servitor trigger, causing each player to draw a card.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
